name: invoice-manager
description: Invoice details and payment tracking module

scripts.format: prettier --write client server package.json README.md DEPLOYMENT.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check client server package.json README.md DEPLOYMENT.md
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
